text.p: Austria's ATX index was trading slightly higher mid-morning on moderate turnover. Market participants forecast the blue-chip index would climb into a 1,480-1,490 points range.
"I can foresee 1,490, but I think 1,500 is still beyond our reach," said a trader.
* ATX up 4.84 points, or 0.34 pct, at 1,478.95
* Top gainer Lenzing up 5.10 pct at 927 schillings. Firm expects to turn a profit in 1998.
* Leading loser brewer Brau Union, down 0.84 pct at 830 schillings.
* August ATX future up eight points at 1,487.0 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
